newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK CONSTRUCTION CONSORTIUM SAYS TAX CASE IS IN COURT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK CONSTRUCTION CONSORTIUM SAYS TAX CASE IS IN COURT.

text.p: The consortium of three Greek construction firms labeled tax-evaders by the finance ministry said they had taken their tax case to court and they would be vindicated.
The consortium made up of construction firms, Proodeftiki , TEB and Sarandopoulos , featured in a list of tax-evaders submitted by Finance Minister Yannos Papandoniou in parliament on Thursday.
The consortium had already taken the case to the Athens administrative court asking for the cancelation of the fine imposed by the finance ministry for alledged tax-evasion, it said.
The Athens administrative court has also accepted the consortium's appeal against paying any portion of the disputed fine and has ordered its suspension, the consortium said.
"Our consortium is absolutely sure that it will be vindicated," it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
